# IT WHITE - full AI-readable summary

IT WHITE is a technology consultancy and product engineering company for technical consulting, internal systems, operational automation, CRM control, AI tools, analytics, integrations, and custom product development.

The agency position:

- IT WHITE does not create isolated bots.
- IT WHITE builds control contours for business processes.
- The core problem is not the absence of AI, but breaks between sales, communications, CRM, data, and employee actions.
- The method starts with process loss, not technology.
- The output is a working system, not a presentation.

## Main offer

IT WHITE designs, implements, and supports systems that connect demand sources, communication channels, CRM, automatic checks, employee actions, AI modules, and management analytics.

Intended process outcomes, subject to measurement in each implementation:

- fewer lost leads;
- clearer responsibility between employees and systems;
- less manual work;
- connected CRM and communication channels;
- measurable demand from advertising, landing pages, and CRM attribution;
- internal tools that match real business processes;
- custom products where ready-made SaaS does not fit.

## Services

### Business process automation

IT WHITE automates repeatable business processes after roles, events, completion criteria, exception handling, and a manual recovery path have been agreed. Deterministic rules are preferred where AI is unnecessary.

Canonical page: https://itwhite.ru/process-automation/

### Business process audit

IT WHITE audits sales, CRM, data, integrations, and operational processes to find where the business loses speed, money, safety, and control.

Canonical page: https://itwhite.ru/business-process-audit/

### Technical IT consulting

IT WHITE independently reviews system architecture, selected code and data paths, infrastructure, delivery practices, observability, and operational risks before modernization, a major development stage, technical due diligence, or a change of contractor. Findings are tied to observed evidence, business impact, and a next verifiable action. The review is not presented as certification, a full penetration test, or a guarantee of performance.

Canonical page: https://itwhite.ru/technical-consulting/

### Formats and pricing

IT WHITE publishes entry formats and budget ranges around Diagnose, Launch, and Operate: process diagnostics, first control contours, support, and product development.

Canonical page: https://itwhite.ru/formats/

### IT WHITE Control

IT WHITE Control is the flagship control system for leads, SLA, responsible owners, next actions, and process risks. It works as a control layer above CRM and communication channels.

Canonical page: https://itwhite.ru/it-white-control/

### CRM automation and lead control

IT WHITE designs CRM automation, SLA control, notifications, widgets, external logic, and integrations so that CRM does not only store leads but returns process risks to work.

Canonical page: https://itwhite.ru/crm-automation/

### Controlled AI automation

IT WHITE embeds AI into actual operations: dialogue analysis, lead classification, document preparation, knowledge bases, quality control, and context analysis. AI is used only where it is more useful than deterministic code.

Canonical page: https://itwhite.ru/ai-automation/

### Demand and attribution

IT WHITE treats search demand as a supporting demand and attribution system: semantic architecture, landing pages, content, technical fixes, analytics, CRM attribution, and management reporting.

Canonical page: https://itwhite.ru/seo-support/

### Custom product development

IT WHITE designs and develops custom product solutions: internal platforms, dashboards, client portals, CRM widgets, AI tools, micro-SaaS MVPs, and industry-specific systems.

Canonical page: https://itwhite.ru/custom-product-development/

### Bitrix24 automation

IT WHITE develops Bitrix24 integrations, webhooks, external handlers, automation scenarios, AI control logic, Telegram notifications, and lead monitoring.

Canonical page: https://itwhite.ru/bitrix24-automation/

### Internal tools

IT WHITE creates dashboards, service panels, employee workplaces, calculators, reports, document generators, and operational interfaces.

Canonical page: https://itwhite.ru/internal-tools/

### Avito analytics

IT WHITE works with Avito demand analytics, geographic demand, advertising opportunity detection, CRM connection, and lead control.

Canonical page: https://itwhite.ru/avito-analytics/

## Product contours and access boundaries

### Avito Geo Demand

Public URL: not claimed.  
Purpose: internal analysis of geographic demand on Avito and regions where demand and promotion may differ.

### Telegram Multiaccount

URL: https://tg.itwhite.ru  
Purpose: provide a unified workspace for several Telegram accounts, dialogue control, response tracking, and later AI classification.

### CRM Lead Control

URL: https://bot.itwhite.ru/admin (authenticated access)  
Purpose: detect potentially unprocessed leads in Bitrix24, analyze context, and return the issue to a working chat.

## Implementation library

IT WHITE publishes 50 industry-specific AI and automation implementation scenarios for sales, support, documents, finance, HR, retail, logistics, manufacturing, construction, services, IT, security, marketing, and management.

Canonical hub: https://itwhite.ru/cases/

Every scenario distinguishes market research from IT WHITE client work and includes:

- the process problem and target operating model;
- the limited role of AI or deterministic automation;
- human responsibility and approval points;
- required systems and integrations;
- measurable process KPIs;
- risks and conditions where automation should not be used;
- citations to public market research or vendor case repositories.

## Method

1. Observe - see how the process works now.
2. Disassemble - break down roles, actions, data, and losses.
3. Design - design a new logic and interface.
4. Launch - create and launch a working version.
5. Connect - integrate CRM, APIs, messengers, and data sources.
6. Measure - check how the process changed in numbers.
7. Productize - scale the solution inside the business or into a product.
